get.summary: Get all reminders for current user
get.description:
Get all reminders for the authenticated user.
SECURITY: Only returns reminders belonging to the authenticated user.

post.description:
Create a new reminder for the authenticated user.
SECURITY: User ID is extracted from JWT token, not from request body.

get.summary: Get currently active reminders to display
get.description:
Get reminders that should be displayed RIGHT NOW based on time, day, and user status.
SECURITY: Only returns active reminders for the authenticated user.

This endpoint is polled by the frontend every 60 seconds.

get.summary: Get a specific reminder by ID
get.description:
Get a specific reminder by ID.
SECURITY: Users can only access their own reminders.

put.description:
Update a reminder.
SECURITY: Users can only update their own reminders.

delete.description:
Delete a reminder.
SECURITY: Users can only delete their own reminders.

patch.description:
Toggle reminder active status (enable/disable).
SECURITY: Users can only toggle their own reminders.

post.description:
Export workout data in CSV or PDF format.

Security Features:
- JWT authentication required (only authenticated users)
- User can only export their own data (user_id from JWT token)
- No data from cache, always fresh from database

Parameters:
- format: 'csv' or 'pdf'
- time_range: 'last_week', 'last_month', 'last_3_months', 'last_6_months', 
              'last_year', 'last_2_years', 'all_time'
